note: Houghton County Equalization publishes parcels only through the Schneider Beacon viewer (proprietary; returned 403 to automated reads) and a Colligo GIS login form. No public ArcGIS REST parcel service or downloadable county parcel file was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches or county, WUPPDR or state pages. Commercial parcel vendors (Regrid, Equator, Rockford, Dynamo) were not treated as county sources.
